basic_info.description: 1240 Stanyan is a gorgeous home situated in the charming Cole Valley neighborhood. The main level boasts a west facing living room with period details, gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops, spacious dining room, home office, two inviting bedrooms, a well-appointed bathroom, and a generous east-facing terrace, perfect for morning coffee. The lower-level apartment, ideal for guests or as a source of additional income, includes an eat-in kitchen, one generous bedroom, a bathroom, and a spacious covered terrace for outdoor enjoyment. Additional highlights of this property include an oversized flat yard, convenient one-car parking, and a large storage room. The location of 1240 Stanyan grants easy access to nature escapes such as Mount Sutro and Tank Hill. Residents also enjoy the convenience of nearby cafes, grocery stores, and a variety of restaurants. Additionally, the area boasts fantastic recreational opportunities with Grattan Playground and Golden Gate Park close by.
